properties.Description:
Canada is uniquely positioned to lead the global shift to a low-carbon economy through strategic investment in critical minerals. With abundant resources – notably in B.C.’s Golden Triangle region, home to 75% of Canada's known copper reserves – the country can play a key role in supplying essential materials for clean energy technologies like solar panels, wind turbines, and EV charging infrastructure.

The content in this collection has been selected to share important information about this region of interest to support assessment of major projects, including in the early planning phase and to support Indigenous consultation and public engagement. Content in this collection includes location-based data, scientific publications, reports and tools covering many topics that are relevant to Northern British Columbia, including the Golden Triangle region.

Critical minerals are vital to both green and digital technologies, including clean energy systems, electric vehicles, semiconductors, and defense applications.  Canada is making efforts to leverage its mineral wealth – from exploration, and mining to processing, manufacturing, and recycling – to align development with long-term economic growth, climate leadership, Indigenous reconciliation, and supply chain resilience.
